title: Sheaf-level affine tensor pullback homology coordinate
statement: For commutative rings A and B, a ring map phi:A to B, a cochain complex M of A-modules and an integer i, let C be the scalar-extended complex, P the tilde complex and T its ordinary tensor pullback. Define tilde(H^i(C)) isomorphic to H^i(Q(T)) by the inverse exact tilde homology isomorphism, the inverse derived homology factorization, and homology of the inverse termwise tensor-pullback comparison [lem-weil-pbc-tilde-pullback-base-change]. These are the first three sheaf-level factors of [def-pc-affine-base-change-tilde-coordinates].

source.place: Tag 01I9 affine tilde comparison; coordinate construction of Tag 0DJ8

Homology and global sections preserve composition of isomorphisms

from.place: The sheaf-level factors of the affine localization coordinate argument.

lean.statement:
def affineTensorPullbackHomologySheafIso
    (A A' : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing A'] (φ : A →+* A')
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (i : ℤ) :
    let P := ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      (@id (ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
          (tilde.functor (.of A))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj M)
    let T := ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    let C := ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M
    (tilde.functor (.of A')).obj (C.homology i) ≅
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A')).toRingedSpace)) i).obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj T)
